categories.label: Road resurfacing
categories.proposal: Repair more neighborhood streets and alleys
categories.description: A rolling repair program. Additional funding expands the amount of resurfacing work; this demo treats the program as scalable.

categories.label: Sidewalk accessibility
categories.proposal: Repair sidewalks and improve accessible routes
categories.description: A program of sidewalk repairs and accessibility improvements. Additional funding supports more work across the neighborhood.

categories.label: Safer crossings
categories.description: One coordinated crossing project with curb extensions, accessible ramps and markings. It needs its full budget to proceed.

categories.label: Trees and shade
categories.proposal: Expand street-tree planting and establishment care
categories.description: A neighborhood planting and care program. Additional funding supports more trees and their establishment; amounts are modeled as scalable.

categories.label: Parks and play spaces
categories.proposal: Complete an accessible neighborhood play area
categories.description: A single play-area renovation including accessible surfacing and equipment. Partial funding cannot deliver the proposed project.

categories.label: Community facilities
categories.proposal: Upgrade a community center’s accessible entrance
categories.description: One complete entrance upgrade with door, access and entryway work. The full cost is required, and extra funding does not expand this proposal.
